title: Manufacturing Yield Rate
scenario: Calculate the moving yield (ratio of passed to total parts) for the last 100 parts produced.
tableSchema: assembly (part_id INT, is_passed BOOLEAN, assembly_date TIMESTAMP)
hint: Use ROWS BETWEEN 99 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
correctQuery: SELECT part_id, AVG(CASE WHEN is_passed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) OVER(ORDER BY assembly_date ROWS BETWEEN 99 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_yield FROM assembly;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE assembly (part_id INT, is_passed BOOLEAN, assembly_date TIMESTAMP);
